anya: heads-up — did a first pass of honeycomb-mini quant experiments (int6). running short-tail + multilingual sanity on staging. seeing odd cluster collapse for very short queries. :confused:

devon: collapse how? give numbers.

anya: baseline float16 recall@1 ~0.63, recall@5 0.85. int6 (global scale) recall@1 ~0.52, recall@5 0.80. silhouette dropped from 0.22 -> 0.11.

kai: did you re-index after quantization?

anya: yes clean index build. used HNSW default params (M=32, ef=64). also tried disabling post-L2 normalize and recall@1 moved to 0.55 but clusters worse visually.

miriam: likely quant-induced anisotropy. int6 global scale often amplifies some dims, squeezing others. try per-channel scaling or asymmetric quant.

anya: running per-channel symmetric int6 + re-fit PCA whitening on quantized embeds now. command I'm using:

```
python encode.py --model honeycomb-mini --quantize int6 --per_channel True --anchor-file data/anchor5k.jsonl --out emb/honeycomb_int6_perchan.npy
python fit_whiten.py --emb emb/honeycomb_int6_perchan.npy --out transforms/honeycomb_int6_whiten.npz
python build_index.py --emb emb/honeycomb_int6_perchan.npy --index hnsw --M 48 --ef_construction 200 --out index/honeycomb_int6_m48
python eval_embeddings.py --index index/honeycomb_int6_m48 --queries data/webqa_shorttail_queries.jsonl --topk 10 --normalize True
```

infra-bot: job scheduled: eval-anchor-5k-honeycomb-int6 (id jb-9642) at 2026-03-21T15:02:00Z.

kai: also check per-query embedding norm distribution by token-count buckets. short queries often have lower magnitude and quant can zero them out.

anya: good call — initial stats show <=6-token queries average norm down 20% after global int6; >20 tokens unchanged.

miriam: that aligns with collapse. quick fix attempt: length-bucket calibration or tiny additive bias after quant to restore expected norm. also try per-channel scale + a 5k anchor calibration step.

devon: plan: 1) per-channel int6 + re-fit whitening 2) per-length bucket scale correction 3) index rebuild with M=48, ef_search 128 4) float16 parity run. success = recall@1 >=0.60 and silhouette >=0.18.

anya: running 1) and 2) now. will post concise results.

anya: quick summary from run #1 (per-channel + re-whiten): recall@1 0.598, recall@5 0.82, silhouette 0.185. short-query norm drop reduced to ~6%.

kai: that's promising — within 5% of baseline for recall. any specific failure modes?

anya: pulled top regressions (50). many are entity normalization/paraphrase tough cases we already flagged. sample attached: /staging/artifacts/honeycomb/int6/perchan/regressions_top50.csv

miriam: good. next: run 50k holdout and multilingual short-query parity. if stable, canary rollout w/ monitoring. also add automated anchor calibration to quant pipeline (PR).

devon: also consider adding a small test in CI that compares anchor norms pre/post quant and fails if short-bucket shift >10%.

anya: filing PR now for pipeline changes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/529 (WIP).

infra-bot: job completed: eval-anchor-5k-honeycomb-int6 (id jb-9642) — status: success. artifacts: /staging/artifacts/honeycomb/int6/perchan/.

kai: nice work. once holdout finishes, let's run a quick A/B with int8-perchannel as fallback to quantify cost vs quality trade-off.

miriam: agreed. thanks for the quick turnaround. :rocket:
